reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Phase 03 correctly identified that the sync path (checkColumnResponse at request_manager.nim:190) only validates inclusion proof, while gossip (validateDataColumnSidecar via verify_data_column_sidecar at peerdas_helpers.nim:359-360) also checks kzg_commitments.len > 0. However, this is not exploitable. Invalid sidecars from sync are stored in quarantine but never persisted to database because they fail block verification. Responses to sync requests come from dag.db (sync_protocol.nim:419), not quarantine, so invalid sidecars are never served to peers. The quarantine uses FIFO eviction, automatically cleaning garbage. This is a code quality issue (validation path asymmetry), not a security vulnerability. Spec reference from 01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json lines 262-279: 'kzg_commitments must not be empty in a valid data column sidecar.' The spec property is correct, but the deviation has no exploitable security impact.
